title: CI/CD for ML
interviewAnswer: CI validates code, data contracts and model tests on change; CD automates safe packaging and deployment after gates. ML adds artifact/data/model validation beyond normal software tests.
why: ML CI/CD extends software testing with data, model and deployment validation.
intuition: CI checks that a change is safe to merge; CD packages and promotes an artifact through environments under explicit quality gates.
deepDive: CI can run lint/unit/integration/schema tests plus lightweight model smoke/regression tests. Heavier training may run separately with artifacts registered after evaluation. CD builds immutable containers/models, deploys to staging, runs health/contract/eval checks, then promotes using canary/blue-green. Data changes and model retraining can occur independently of code changes, so lineage matters.
workedExample: A PR changes preprocessing: CI tests feature schema and golden examples. After merge, a training pipeline produces model v14, evaluation gates pass, container+model are deployed to staging and then canary production.
commonMistakes: Retraining a huge model on every code commit.
Having software tests but no data/model regression gates.
followUps: How does ML CD differ from normal software?
How do you promote a model?
How do you handle data-only changes?
production: Use immutable versions, reproducible builds, environment promotion, approval/eval gates and rollback automation tied to model+preprocessing lineage.
